chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
When you fear a matter, say: 'O Allah! You are such that no one suffices from You, and You suffice from every one of Your creatures; therefore, suffice me with such and such.'

And in another hadith, he said: 'You should say: 'O Sufficer from every thing, and nothing suffices from You in the heavens and the earth! Suffice me for what worries me from the affairs of the world and the Hereafter, and send blessings upon Muhammad and his Progeny.'

And Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'The one who enters upon a ruler whom he fears, let him say: 'By Allah I commence, and by Allah I shall succeed, and by Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) I divert to Him. O Allah! Ease for me his difficulty and make his harshness easy for me, for You erase what You will and confirm, and with You is the Mother of the Book.'

And you should also say: 'Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god except Him, upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Magnificent Throne. And I seek refuge by the might and strength of Allah from their might and their strength, and I seek refuge by the Lord of Al-Falaq from the evil of what He created, and there is no might nor strength except with Allah.'
ai.seo_question: What are the recommended supplications for fear and entering the presence of a ruler in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi outlines specific supplications for navigating fear and anxiety, particularly when entering the presence of a ruler, emphasizing the concept of Allah's sufficiency (kafa'ah) as a source of spiritual strength. It integrates Quranic verses such as Ayat al-Kursi and Surah Al-Falaq to provide a comprehensive framework for seeking protection from both external threats and internal worries, reflecting the Shia tradition of combining verbal invocation with divine attributes. The text highlights the practical application of tawakkul (trust in God) in high-stakes social and political interactions, reinforcing the belief that Allah alone is the ultimate protector and decider of affairs.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Whenever you fear a matter, so say, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! You<sup>azwj</sup> are such that no one suffices from You<sup>azwj</sup> and You<sup>azwj</sup> Suffice from every one from Your<sup>azwj</sup> creatures, therefore Suffice me with such and such’.

And in another Hadeeth, heasws said: ‘You should be sayin, ‘O Sufficient from every thing and nothing suffices from Youazwj, in the skies and the earth! Suffice me for what worries me from the matters of the world and the Hereafter, and Send Salawāt upon Muhammadsaww and the Progenyasws of Muhammadsaww’’.

And Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who goes over to a ruling authority to be awarded, so let him say, ‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup> I commence and by Allah<sup>azwj</sup> I shall succeed, and by Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> I divert to Him<sup>azwj</sup>. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Overcome for me his difficult attitude and Ease for me his ruthlessness, for You<sup>azwj</sup> Delete whatever You<sup>azwj</sup> so Desire to and Affirm, and with You<sup>azwj</sup> is the Mother of the Book’.

And you should be saying as well, ‘Allahazwj Suffices for me. There is no God except Himazwj. Upon Himazwj do I rely, and Heazwj is the Lordazwj of the Magnificent Throne, and I refrain by the Might of Allahazwj and Hisazwj Strength, from their (tyrants) might and their strength. And I refrain by the Lordazwj of Al Falaq (a chasm in Hell), from the evil of what Heazwj Created, and there is neither Might nor Strength except with Allahazwj’’.
en.sarwar: 7. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Sama’a from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:
“When you are afraid of something say, ‘O Lord, no one is an alternative for You and You are the alternative for everyone of Your creatures, suffice me in such and such matters.’”

“In another Hadith the Imam (a.s.) has instructed to say this, ‘O the One who suffices in everything and nothing is sufficient for Him in the heavens and earth, suffice me in what is important to me of worldly and the hereafter and bestow al-Salat (favors) upon Muhammad and his family.’

“Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has also said, ‘If anyone feels apprehensive in the presence of a ruler, he should say, “By the help of Allah, I seek conquest, by the power of Allah I will achieve success and through Muhammad (a.s.) I turn to (Allah). O Lord, ease up his difficult attitude for me, and soften for me his hardheartedness; You delete what You will, and establish. With You there is the original book.”

Also say, ‘Allah is sufficient for me, no one deserves to be worshipped except Allah and I place my trust in Allah. He is the Lord of the Great Throne, through the means of Allah and His power I seek (from Allah) to prevent their means and power (from harming me), I seek prevention by the Lord, who opens up the dawn, against the evil of what He has created, there are no means and no power without Allah.’”
